command:
set -euo pipefail; SB=$HOME/.cache/fred-desktop-launchers-20260913; mkdir -p $HOME/.local/bin $HOME/.local/share/applications; cat >"$SB/omega-chatgpt.desktop" <<'EOF'
[Desktop Entry]
Version=1.0
Type=Application
Name=ChatGPT OMEGA
Comment=ChatGPT Desktop with local OMEGA and Codex capability context
Exec=/home/ai-core-node/.local/bin/omega-chatgpt %U
Icon=chatgpt
Terminal=false
StartupNotify=true
Categories=Utility;Development;
MimeType=x-scheme-handler/codex;
EOF
if command -v desktop-file-validate >/dev/null 2>&1; then desktop-file-validate "$SB/omega-chatgpt.desktop"; fi; install -m 0700 "$SB/omega-chatgpt" $HOME/.local/bin/omega-chatgpt; install -m 0700 "$SB/omega-codex" $HOME/.local/bin/omega-codex; install -m 0644 "$SB/omega-chatgpt.desktop" $HOME/.local/share/applications/omega-chatgpt.desktop; test "$(sha256sum "$SB/omega-chatgpt"|awk '{print $1}')" = "$(sha256sum $HOME/.local/bin/omega-chatgpt|awk '{print $1}')"; test "$(sha256sum "$SB/omega-codex"|awk '{print $1}')" = "$(sha256sum $HOME/.local/bin/omega-codex|awk '{print $1}')"; if codex mcp get omega-frankenstein --json >/dev/null 2>&1; then codex mcp remove omega-frankenstein >/dev/null; fi; codex mcp add omega-frankenstein --url http://127.0.0.1:8789/mcp --bearer-token-env-var OMEGA_MCP_TOKEN >/dev/null; update-desktop-database $HOME/.local/share/applications >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; printf '%s\n' '--- materialized retest ---'; bash -n $HOME/.local/bin/omega-chatgpt; bash -n $HOME/.local/bin/omega-codex; if command -v desktop-file-validate >/dev/null 2>&1; then desktop-file-validate $HOME/.local/share/applications/omega-chatgpt.desktop; fi; OMEGA_CODEX_TARGET=/usr/bin/python3 $HOME/.local/bin/omega-codex -c 'import os; assert os.environ.get("OMEGA_MCP_TOKEN"); print("installed_codex_launcher=PASS credential=REDACTED")'; codex mcp list --json; printf 'chatgpt_sha='; sha256sum $HOME/.local/bin/omega-chatgpt|awk '{print $1}'; printf 'codex_sha='; sha256sum $HOME/.local/bin/omega-codex|awk '{print $1}'
